title: PowerShell Defense Evasion Techniques
summary: Investigated how threat actors use PowerShell obfuscation and AMSI bypass to evade detection, with detection strategies using Sysmon and Event Viewer.
scenario: Attackers increasingly use PowerShell as their primary execution framework due to its deep integration with Windows and ability to bypass application whitelisting.
objective: Map common PowerShell evasion techniques to MITRE ATT&CK and develop detection rules.
keyFindings: AMSI bypass attempts leave detectable event traces
Script block logging (Event ID 4104) is the most reliable detection source
Encoded commands have predictable entropy patterns
outcome: Created detection playbook for PowerShell-based attacks with Sysmon configuration and Splunk queries.
